summary: Plan to fix 3 Lossless.dll playback issues: (1) accurate 24fps base frame rate detection instead of 120Hz monitor refresh rate, (2) 100% untouched native video quality when LSFG is turned off (and zero downscaling/ghosting when active), and (3) 5-second auto-hide for the top Lossless.dll watermark alongside the bottom HUD menu.
